audience: store managers and retail staff who look up stock, customers and orders in Heartland Retail

useCases.title: Check stock quantities by location
useCases.text: List the store's locations to find their ids. Then list the inventory values, grouped by location, to read the stock quantities and values the tool returns.

useCases.title: Find a customer by email and review their orders
useCases.text: Search the customers by email and open the match to read its details and loyalty points. Then search the sales orders for that customer's name.

useCases.title: Review pending sales orders and their lines
useCases.text: List the sales orders filtered by status, such as pending. Open one order to read its lines with the items, quantities and prices.

useCases.title: Check a gift card or a POS sale
useCases.text: Read the value and status of a gift card by its card number. Search the point-of-sale tickets for a till sale.

useCases.title: Create a customer or change a customer's email
useCases.text: Create a customer with a first name or a last name. Or update the name or email of an existing customer. Only the fields you give change.
